invariantFamilies.note: Part E whole-repo audit (2026-07-11) found 5 CONFIRMED_MEDIUM violations. Previously under-reported as 0. All deferred to R1.

mustFixFindings.fixDescription: Wrapped ownerFinancialSnapshot.create and emitAuditEvent(input, tx) in db.$transaction

deferredFindings.description: Owner-module snapshot/diagnosis/override POST routes (22+ routes) have no idempotency guard — creates OwnerCashflowSnapshot, OwnerFinancialSnapshot, OwnerSalesSnapshot, OwnerMarketingSnapshot, OwnerOperationsSnapshot, OwnerSopSnapshot, OwnerStrategySnapshot, OwnerMetricSnapshot, OwnerBusiness, OwnerCycle family, OwnerOverride, budget authority, working-capital, archetype-metrics, and action-verify routes. Period/cycle uniqueness constraints provide partial protection but not idempotency.
deferredFindings.rationale: Scope requires systematic idempotency-key enforcement across the owner module POST surface; Phase R1 work item

deferredFindings.description: Additional services with non-atomic create+audit — confirmed scope from Part E audit: budget.service.ts (7 functions: createBudgetPeriod, addBudgetLine, updateBudgetLineAmount, recordSpendEntry, updateSpendProofStatus, updateSpendReconciliation, reassessBudget), createBusiness, createEngagement (audit outside idempotency wrapper), recordDoNotRepeat, createCashflowSnapshot, createSalesSnapshot, and all domain snapshot/diagnosis services (marketing, operations, SOP, strategy). recordSpendEntry is highest priority — financial trust anchor.

CI lane truthfulness violations — 5 CONFIRMED_MEDIUM findings: (a) ci.yml:191 lint run non-blocking via continue-on-error; (b) phase-3-slice-2-truth-pass.yml:109 dual-suppression of eslint on event-emitter.ts and recommendation.ts; (c) owner-real-world-smb-cases.yml:35 tsc || true; (d) owner-real-world-simulation.yml:35 tsc || true; (e) owner-mode-holdout.yml:35 tsc || true. Also: resolve-failed-migration.yml:314 vitest || true.
deferredFindings.rationale: Each suppression was likely added to unblock CI rather than to hide real failures. Fix requires per-workflow review and replacing || true with proper continue-on-error: true on advisory steps.
